prerequisites: Student is familiar with the differential and integral calculus of function of one variable and other branches of mathematics used in this calculus, particularly linear algebra.
Student is able to calculate derivatives of functions of one variable, indefinite and definite integrals using methods by parts and by substitution.
Student is able to calculate determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrix.

learning_outcomes.text: Student has theoretical knowledge of differential equations and knows methods of their solving.
Student has knowledge about methods of solving of systems of differential equations.
Student has knowledge about applying differential equations as the mathematical model for a physical phenomenon.
Student is able to formulate theorems and definitions of differential equations in oral and written, friendly manner,
Student is able to solve first-order and second-order differential equations.
Student is able to solve systems of differential equations.
Student understands the necessity of systematical work on all tasks and can estimate the time needed for solving the exercise.
Student knows the scope of his/her knowledge and abilities, is able to identify lack of knowledge and complete it using the literature.
Student acts ethically and understands the importance of intellectual honesty,

syllabus_topics: First-order differential equations: the basic definitions. Issues from various fields leading to differential equations. First-order differential equations: the equations with separated variables and homogeneous equations.
First-order linear homogeneous and heterogeneous differential equations. Method of variation of constant.
Orthogonal curves. Second-order equations. Reducible second-order equations.
Second-order linear homogeneous differential equations. Wronskian. Second-order linear homogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients.
Second-order linear heterogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients. Method of variation of constants. Method of undetermined coefficients.
Systems of differential equations. Method of elimination. Homogeneous linear system of equations with constant coefficients.
Heterogeneous linear system of equations with constant coefficients. Method of variation of constants.
Reminder on differential and integral calculus. Solving first-order differential equations with separated variables and homogeneous equations.
Solving first-order linear homogeneous and heterogeneous differential equations.
Solving second-order linear homogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients.
Solving second-order linear heterogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients with method of undetermined coefficients.
Solving second-order linear heterogeneous differential equations with constant coefficients with method of variation of constants.
Solving heterogeneous linear systems of equations with constant coefficients.
Final test (Classes) (in case of evaluation on base of short tests, 2 hours are necessary to perform them during semester).
assessment_rules: The concluding mark P is calculated as 2/3 of the F1 lecture mark and 1/3 of the F1 classes mark. Both F1 marks must be greater than 2.0 to pass.
